goodToKnow: Das Kriegsende is the end of a war; in Germany it usually means 8 May 1945, the unconditional surrender. In a landmark 1985 speech, President Richard von Weizsäcker called 8 May a Tag der Befreiung (day of liberation), a view now widely accepted. The period afterwards is called die Stunde null (zero hour). Berlin made 8 May 2025, the 80th anniversary, a one-off public holiday. It has no plural.
